scope: frozen repeated-sample diagnostic settings and status policy; full Task 2 protocol remains draft
request_mode: one independent chat completion per sample index
seed_rule: seed = 1729 + sample_index; indices 0 through 9, shared across cases and models
pilot: one selected clean development BFCL case with Qwen 1.5B
pilot_report: user reported 10/10 complete with valid token evidence, canonical cluster sizes (9, 1), disagreement 0.1; Drive audit not independently inspected

status_policy.complete: cluster the pinned parser's type-aware canonical call key; exact-string ablation uses the visible output
status_policy.invalid_evidence: if text is otherwise complete, retain its parser/canonical outcome for probability-free clustering; invalidate token-probability scores separately
status_policy.truncated: one truncated canonical outcome regardless of whether partial text parses; exact-string ablation keeps status and partial visible text
status_policy.request_error: one request-error canonical outcome for a terminal failed slot; exact-string ablation keeps status and any saved text; retry on resume without adding a slot
status_policy.empty: distinct canonical outcome for blank visible text
status_policy.explicit_no_calls: distinct canonical outcome only for a visible []
status_policy.unparsed_or_no_call: one canonical outcome for nonempty text with no calls from the pinned parser, without inferring whether no tool was intended
status_policy.parse_failure: one canonical outcome for parser errors or invalid parsed-call structures
status_policy.denominator: keep all ten slots, including failed or incomplete outcomes; do not impute missing token scores

decision_context: Frozen after reviewing the three 30-case development audits: 900 slots, 896 complete and four truncated, 90 model-case cluster scores; truncation handling was added after inspecting Qwen 1.5B development output. No held-out perturbation groups were used.
